auth_authenticator.description: Validation method to prove domain ownership. Common: 'standalone', 'webroot', 'apache', 'nginx'.

auth_webroot_path.description: Web root directory for HTTP-01 challenge files (only if using 'webroot' authenticator).

auth_webroot_map.description: Per-domain webroot paths. Use when different domains have different web roots.

path.description: Web root directory for this domain (e.g., '/var/www/example').

auth_authenticator_flags.description: Extra plugin-specific flags for the authenticator (e.g., '--standalone-supported-challenges http-01').

installer_installer.description: How to install the certificate on the server. 'apache', 'nginx', or 'none' if manual install.

installer_installer_flags.description: Extra plugin-specific flags for the installer plugin.

email.description: Email for expiration warnings and security notices. Required for account registration.

tos.description: URL of the subscriber agreement to accept. Leave blank to accept latest.

agree_to_tos.description: Whether to automatically agree to the subscriber agreement during registration.

preferred_challenges.description: Order of challenge types to prefer. Valid values: 'http-01', 'dns-01'. TLS-SNI-01 is deprecated.

rsa_key_size.description: RSA key size for new certificates (in bits). 2048 (minimum), 3072, or 4096 recommended.

staging.description: Use the Let's Encrypt staging environment (rate-limits are higher; certs are untrusted).

reuse_key.description: Reuse the existing private key when renewing a certificate.

renew_by_default.description: Automatically renew certificates if they expire in ≤30 days. (Deprecated; prefer CLI flags.)

install_certificate.description: Automatically install the certificate after obtaining it (requires an installer plugin).

work_dir.description: Working directory for Certbot state (temp files, challenges).

config_dir.description: Config directory for certificates, account keys, and CLI config.

domains.description: List of domain names to include in the certificate (SANs). Required for issuance.

server.description: ACME server URL. Use 'https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory' for staging.

keep_logs.description: Keep log files after successful renewal (default: cleaned up).

disable_auto_renewal.description: Disable automatic renewal via cron/systemd timer.

account.description: Path to existing account private key (e.g., '/etc/letsencrypt/account.json'). Auto-generated if empty.

force_interactive.description: Force interactive mode even if stdin is not a terminal (e.g., in some containers).
